name: Aviation Weather Center Data API

provider.name: NOAA National Weather Service, Aviation Weather Center

summary: Official US aviation weather: METAR, TAF, PIREP, SIGMET, AIRMET and airport and station metadata, free without a key.
description: The AWC data API serves decoded and raw aviation weather products worldwide, including METAR observations, TAF forecasts, pilot reports, SIGMETs and AIRMETs, plus airport and station information. Most endpoints take ICAO identifiers or a bounding box and return JSON, GeoJSON, XML or raw text.

rate_limit.summary: Not documented on the pages I fetched.

endpoints.summary: Current METARs by station or bounding box
Pilot reports (needs ids with distance, or bbox)

license.name: US Government (NOAA/NWS) data; no licence statement on the API pages I fetched

coverage.geographic: Global METAR/TAF, US-centred for other products
coverage.temporal: Current and recent hours; archive not served here

agent_notes: Pass format=json. ids takes comma-separated ICAO codes. Temperatures are Celsius, altimeter in hPa, elevation in metres in the sample. Empty results return 204 or an empty list, and some endpoints answer 400 when neither stations nor a bbox is given.
caveats: The first METAR call took about 4 s; later calls were faster.
Rate limits and licence terms were not found in the docs I fetched, so check the site before heavy use.

verification.notes: Exact example executed without a key; taf, airport, stationinfo and airsigmet also answered 200.
